in_sanskrit.name: Bapu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Father, Teacher
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bapu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Bapu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Baba’, meaning father. In Hinduism, Bapu is also used as a title for revered teachers or spiritual guides. This name is associated with wisdom, compassion, and authority.
